---
title: "jira.edcpptp_field_catalog"
description: "Every Jira field definition, with EDCPPTP usage counts, one row per field per snapshot."
---

A lookup from Jira field IDs to their names and types, with how many EDCPPTP
issues use each field.

Each row is one Jira field definition (`field_id`) as it stood on one snapshot
`date`. Use it to find the name and type behind a `customfield_*` key in
[`edcpptp.custom_fields_json`](edcpptp.qmd#custom-fields). Join on `field_id`
and `date`.

`Keywords`: jira, edcpptp, custom fields, field names, field IDs, lookup, schema

## Provenance

Written by the `edcpptp-sync` Lambda in the same run as [`edcpptp`](edcpptp.qmd),
from Jira's field list (`GET /rest/api/3/field`). The field list holds field
definitions only, not issue values.

* **Updated**: Daily, at ~06:15 ET
* **Retention**: Pending. To be set at a retention meeting.
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca) (Data and Research team)
* **Location**: `s3://canadalogin-reporting-transformed/edcpptp/field_catalog/`

## Fields

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| date | string | Partition key: the UTC date the Lambda ran (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| field_id | string | Jira field ID, e.g. `customfield_13558` or `summary`. Matches the keys in `edcpptp.custom_fields_json`. |
| field_name | string | Jira display name, e.g. `Current Phase`. |
| custom | boolean | Is this a custom field? `false` means a built-in Jira field. |
| schema_type | string | Jira value type, e.g. `string`, `number`, `date`, `option`, `array`. |
| custom_schema | string | Jira custom field type, e.g. `com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.customfieldtypes:select`. Null for built-in fields. |
| populated_count | integer | Number of EDCPPTP issues in the snapshot with a value in this field. |
| included_in_json | boolean | Is this field written to `edcpptp.custom_fields_json`? `true` only for allow-listed custom fields. |
| fetched_at | string | UTC timestamp when the Lambda wrote this row (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). |

## Notes

**Promoted fields are not in the JSON.** Built-in fields such as `status`, and
the custom field `customfield_12614` (`Start date`), have their own columns in
`edcpptp`. They have `included_in_json` set to `false`.
